data.name: Morning 2-Tank Dive: Vandenberg Wreck
data.headline: 4.5 Hours • Dive the World's 2nd largest Artificial Reef with us! • Ages 15+
data.description:
During our exhilarating 2-tank morning wreck dive, we explore the legendary USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg, renowned as the world’s second-largest artificial reef. This majestic naval ship, purposefully sunk in 2009, serves as Key West’s most expansive and captivating artificial reef.

Located approximately 6 miles south-southeast of Key West within the pristine Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary (FKNMS), the Vandenberg rests at a depth of 140 feet. Our adventure takes us to a maximum depth of 100 feet, allowing us to navigate the expansive deck of this colossal vessel.

The dive unveils an underwater landscape teeming with marine biodiversity, with the ship’s towering structures now encrusted with colorful corals and bustling with vibrant sea life. Each tank offers a unique perspective—whether gliding along the deck’s remnants or peering into the ship’s intriguing corridors, the Vandenberg promises an unforgettable underwater experience.

data.booking_notes:
#VANDENBERG WRECK DIVE - ADVANCED DIVE (READ CAREFULLY)
**This is an advanced, high risk dive. Not for beginners.**

Please read everything below carefully before arrival. 

#CHECK-IN LOCATION 
*Southpoint Divers*
- [606 Front St, Key West, FL 33040](https://goo.gl/maps/LDskY2AXDky), Our 46' custom dive boat, The Phoenix, docks at the Hyatt Marina, across the street from the shop. 

**Arrival Time: 8:00am SHARP**
-Boat departs from Hyatt Centric (across the street) at 8:30am
-We do not wait for late arrivals 
**Late arrivals = missed dive, no refund**

#Required Experience 
**The Vandenberg is a deep, advanced wreck dive with potential for:**
-Strong currents 
-Limited visibility 
-Depth and overhead environments 
**To participate, you must,**
-Be Advanced Open Water certified (or equivalent)
-Have dived within the last 12 months
-Be comfortable in deeper water and variable conditions 
-Open Water Certified **MUST** have dived within the last 6 months and **REQUIRES** a guide ($50)

#MEDICAL (FOR REFERENCE)

**[PADI Medical Form](https://www.padi.com/sites/default/files/documents/2022-12/Diver_Medical_Participant_Questionnaire_10346_EN_English_2022-02-01.pdf)**

- This is provided as reference for general dive fitness
- if you have any medical concerns, you are responsible for obtaining Doctor clearance prior to arrival

#WHAT TO BRING
- Certification card **(required)**
- Towel & swimsuit 
- We encourage you to use mineral-based reef safe sunscreen and use Ultraviolet Protection Factor (UPF) sunwear.
-**Recommended**
- motion sickness prevention 
- surface marker Buoy

#OPTIONAL BUT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED 
- **Guide ($50)** - Strongly recommend if unfamiliar with the Vandenberg
- **Dive computer (required if you do not have one)**
- GoPro Rental 

#DIVE CONDITIONS 
- 2-tank wreck dive
- Conditions vary daily 
- This is a serious dive profile 

#IMPORTANT REMINDERS
**No flying within 24 hours after diving**
*Ocean conditions are unpredictable- plan accordingly*

#CREW GRATUITY 
**If you had a great experience**
- Typical gratuity: 15-20% per person 

*Always appreciated, Never required* 

#Please watch this short video 
Please watch this short [video](https://nmsfloridakeys.blob.core.windows.net/floridakeys-prod/media/videos/reef-etiquette.mp4) to learn more about diving and snorkeling in Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary and how you can help to protect this special place!
